cards.attributes: Provides one ember or one tide each turn. The mesa chooses for you.
cards.name: Shifting Mesa

cards.attributes: A shadow with no owner. It guards the gates that no longer exist.
cards.name: Hollow Sentinel

cards.arg_fragment: The meme was the first prophecy. We just thought it was a joke.
cards.attributes: Such power. Very realm. When played, all players must speak its name aloud or lose their turn.
cards.name: Doge

cards.attributes: Its worth rises every time someone believes in it — which is also its only weakness.
cards.name: Stonks Golem

cards.arg_fragment: One diamond. One door. One price you cannot afford twice.
cards.attributes: The first gem ever minted. Ownership is verified on-chain. Its bearer may trade with the dark trader
cards.name: Genesis Diamond

cards.attributes: A 64×64 memory of a world that never loaded. Verified on-chain.
cards.name: Pixel Relic

cards.arg_fragment: Its badge never worked. It never needed one. The null serial was never lost — it was waiting to be hired.
cards.attributes: Indestructible. At the end of each turn, The Temp devours an opposing token and gains its power. Return it to your hand only by paying 3 sanity — the contract cannot be renewed forever.
cards.name: The Temp

cards.arg_fragment: The wisp remembers a door that was never closed.
cards.attributes: A faint spirit of the first dawn. Flying. When summoned, reveal the top fragment of your realm.
cards.name: Aether Wisp

cards.attributes: Swift. Deals damage equal to the number of cards you hold.
cards.name: Glintwing Scout

cards.attributes: Deal 3 damage to any target. If a Land burned this turn, draw a card.
cards.name: Rune of Embers

cards.attributes: Freeze an opposing artifact until your next turn.
cards.name: Tidebinding

cards.arg_fragment: It doesn't hold time. It holds the debt.
cards.attributes: Once per turn, rewind one action. The realm remembers what you undid.
cards.name: The Chronolith

cards.attributes: Reveal any hidden card. What you see through it sees you back.
cards.name: Voidlens Prism
